scope: Unique explicit concrete display IDs in vanilla data/json for eight renderable categories plus runtime IDs from upstream CPP_IDS and required lighting/fallback IDs. Mods, derived vehicle variants, field intensities, overmap rotation/line suffixes, corpses, equipment/mutation overlays, seasonal/variant IDs, effects and runtime generated IDs are not included in this denominator. Static candidates can include pseudo/obsolete entries; not an all-runtime-ID count.
game_integration: not installed/selected; engine runtime not tested
imagegen_usage: 17 original mood/concept drafts only. All final artwork explicitly authored as native palette-cell source matrices; no draft pixels sampled.
